sentences.text:
Sanjeevan Toppo S/o Maksimiliyanus Aged About 35 Years Caste-Uraon, R/
 O Village Bahora, Tahsil And P.S. Sanna, District Jashpur Chhattisgarh.

---- Applicant
 Versus
  State Of Chhattisgarh Through - Station House Officer, Police Station Sanna,
 District Jashpur Chhattisgarh.

---- Respondent
For Applicant : Shri Arun Kumar Shukla, Advocate For State : Ms. Binu Sharma, Panel Lawyer
Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput Order On Board 20/01/2023 Heard.
1.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.99/2022 registered at police station - Sanna, District - Jashpur (CG) for alleged commission of offences under Section 376, 376 (2) (L),
366, 341, 506 (B) of IPC.
2. Case of prosecution in brief, is that when the prosecutrix was going in the field for work, the applicant forcibly took her towards one baadi and committed rape on her.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
The prosecutrix is aged about 45 years and there is delay of two days in lodging FIR.

It is submitted that the medical report does not support the case of the prosecution, the applicant is in jail since 03/09/2022 and trial is likely to take some time.
4.

On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes prayer and submits that in the statement of the prosecutrix under Section 164 CrPC, she has categorically leveled allegations of sexual intercourse and also threat of life given by the applicant.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly statement of the prosecutrix in her 164 CrPC statement, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
